evaluate: ()=>{const checkpoints=[[0,10],[14,-12],[12,-26],[0,-35],[7,-38],[12,-42]];for(const[x,z]of checkpoints){const r=Realm.test.move(x,z);if(!r.ok)throw Error(r.error);let i=0;while(Realm.test.path.length&&i++<18000)Realm.test.step(.05);if(i>=18000)throw Error('setup walking timeout');}Realm.test.view({yaw:1.2,elevation:.4,distance:9});Realm.test.render();return{label:'ACCELERATED PRODUCTION-WALKING SETUP ONLY; ensuing walk/UI/bridge use normal RAF',scene:Realm.diagnostics.scene};}

()=>{const m=window.__roadTiming={enabled:true,last:null,scenes:{},started:performance.now()};const tick=t=>{if(!m.enabled)return;if(m.last!==null){const key=document.body.classList.contains('in-earth')?'Hearthwater-road':'Coastward-bridge';(m.scenes[key]||(m.scenes[key]=[])).push(t-m.last);}m.last=t;requestAnimationFrame(tick);};requestAnimationFrame(tick);return{label:'Headless recorded normal-RAF callback intervals on shared desktop; exclude accelerated setup; not foreground FPS qualification'};}

()=>{const m=window.__roadTiming;m.enabled=false;const stats={};for(const[k,rows]of Object.entries(m.scenes)){const s=rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b),q=p=>s[Math.min(s.length-1,Math.floor((s.length-1)*p))];stats[k]={callbacks:rows.length,p50_ms:q(.5),p95_ms:q(.95),p99_ms:q(.99),max_ms:s.at(-1),intervals_over_50ms:rows.filter(v=>v>50).length};}return{label:'Actual recorded headless RAF intervals, includes menus and recorder/shared-desktop overhead; not displayed FPS or GPU timer',duration_ms:performance.now()-m.started,scenes:stats};}
